doc.title: Dick Spottswood interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 13, 2023

title: Moving heavy 78 collections
summary: A short exchange about the weight and hassle of moving 78 rpm records.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: I’m picturing you in your physical moves over the years. I remember in college we would have our boxes of LPs and then I have accepted a few collections of 78s here. And when I went to move them I was reminded of how fast technology moves with recording mediums.
Each of those 78 RPM records weighs half a pound. So people that have to move them fairly often probably wind up getting back surgery.
I had to move mine again three years ago and I was glad I didn’t have so many.
